title: Beef Brisket Empanadas
description: A twist on traditional empanadas, filled with tender beef brisket and served with a side of zesty roasted sauce.
instructions: Season the beef brisket with brazilian seasoning.
Heat a skillet over medium heat and sear the beef brisket until browned on both sides.
Transfer the beef to a baking dish and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
While the beef is cooking, mix together the torn toast and zesty roasted (homemade or store-bought) sauce in a bowl.
Once the beef is done, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing thinly against the grain.
Assemble the empanadas by placing a slice of beef inside each pastry and serving with the toast-zesty sauce mixture on the side.
